about_the_game:
The M270 makes a stunning arrival! It is the absolute master of battlefield firepower, opening up a thrilling new combat experience for you.

Powerful Firepower: As a long-range fire support vehicle, the M270 has a powerful firepower output. It can conduct area - covering strikes on large-scale target areas in a short time, causing huge damage to enemy cluster targets, defensive fortifications, etc. In team battles, it can effectively suppress the enemy, creating offensive opportunities for one's own side or reducing the defensive pressure.

Longer Range: In the game, its range is much longer than that of some similar vehicles, such as the TOS - 11. This enables players operating the M270 to launch attacks outside the enemy's attack range, taking the initiative in the battle. They can carry out fire strikes on the enemy from a safe distance, reducing the risk of being counter-attacked.

Certain Defense: Compared with vehicles like the TOS - 1, the M270 has better protection and more health, being able to endure more damage. This makes its survival ability on the battlefield relatively strong. With certain cover, it can better resist the enemy's counter- firepower and increase its continuous combat ability.

Quickly get it and start this passionate journey!

The gift package includes:

level 5 M270

5000 Gold
The in-game items will be directly issued to your in-game backpack after purchase. Please go to check them within the game.

The DLC can only be added to your "Tank Arena: Total Action" account once.

This DLC is only applicable to game accounts created on the Steam platform.
